elements.desc: A middle-aged man with a distinctive black beard and black-rimmed glasses, wearing a burgundy blazer over a white t-shirt and dark blue jeans, holding a black tablet and gesturing with one hand raised.
A yellow corduroy pillow and a black and white geometric pattern pillow on the deep purple velvet couch.
